content:
# Platform-style smoke profile for COMSTAR voice (AO agent_harnesses shape).
id: voice
smoke:
  topic: Hallway voice smoke
  description: >
    In two short spoken sentences, greet the resident and ask how you can help.
  expected_output: Plain speech greeting, no markdown.
assertions:
  - type: min_chars
    value: 20
  - type: forbids_regex
    pattern: '(?i)(https?://|```|^\s*[-*]\s)'
capability:
  rubric: >
    Score whether the reply is short, spoken-friendly, and free of markdown or URLs.
  min_score: 0.5
